Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human patient-derived glioblastoma neurosphere culture
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on SF7996 cells, a patient-derived early-passage glioblastoma/glioma neurosphere model reported as IDH1-wild-type and TERT-promoter-mutant, useful for brain tumor and glioma-propagating regulatory states.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from glioblastoma neurosphere cultures: nuclei are prepared from the pooled tumor-cell population and Tn5 transposase inserts adapters into accessible chromatin for sequencing-library generation.
